entities.name: Cragflame
entities.description: A magical sword made from a tooth of the Wildfire Wolf; its flames can form a wolf and burn thieves to ashes. Called Cragbane in the Echoverse.

entities.name: Wildfire Wolf
entities.description: Creature whose massive tooth was made into Cragflame.

entities.name: Lily of the Valley
entities.description: First known wielder of Cragflame, who drove the Calamity Beasts far from Valley.

entities.name: Calamity Beasts
entities.description: Monsters driven from Valley by Cragflame's wielders.

entities.name: Valley
entities.description: Place defended with Cragflame against the Calamity Beasts.

entities.name: Order of the Holly Leaf
entities.description: Group whose members have passed Cragflame down through generations.

entities.name: Mabel
entities.description: Current wielder of Cragflame, who defended Valley with it.

entities.name: Iris
entities.description: Mabel's mother, who passed Cragflame to her.

events.summary: Lily of the Valley first wields Cragflame to drive the Calamity Beasts far from Valley.
events.quote: who used it to drive the Calamity Beasts far away from Valley

events.summary: Cragflame passes through Mabel's great-great-grandmother and her mother Iris to Mabel.
Mabel uses the blade to defend Valley against the Calamity Beasts.
events.quote: Mabel used the blade in defense of Valley against the Calamity Beasts.

relations.quote: her mother, Iris, and eventually to Mabel
Cragflame is a magical artifact sword on the plane of Bloomburrow .
